item.title: Luthra brothers’ passports suspended as Goa nightclub fire probe widens
item.description: The Goa nightclub fire probe has tightened with passports of key accused Gaurav and Saurabh Luthra now suspended. Officials say the action, taken under Section 10A of the Passports Act, 1967, blocks their travel as the investigation gathers pace.

item.title: Congress protests mass tree felling and tribal displacement in Singrauli
item.description: Tensions escalated in Singrauli district on Wednesday as Congress leaders staged protests alleging large-scale tree felling and the displacement of tribal communities to pave the way for a coal mining project linked to a private conglomerate.

item.title: Mumbai Customs seize hydroponic weed, gold, diamonds worth Rs 45 cr; 12 held
item.description: Mumbai Customs have seized hydroponic cannabis, gold and diamonds worth Rs 45 crore at the city airport, officials said on Wednesday, adding that 12 passengers have been arrested.

item.title: Storm Byron batters Gaza, deepening crisis for displaced Palestinians
item.description: Storm Byron lashes Gaza with heavy rain, strong winds and hail, worsening conditions for hundreds of thousands of displaced Palestinians. Families in flooded tents seek help while many flee to find dry ground.
